issue: save() opens an exclusive evidence FD before os.fdopen(). If fdopen construction raises (e.g. MemoryError under the imposed memory cap), no finally closes the raw FD. The retained owner process keeps an untracked descriptor; this affects once-marker, operator-input and return-receipt writes. Pure actual-function injection reproduces open -> fdopen error, no close.
fix: Give the raw FD a cleanup guard until ownership is successfully transferred to the stream; close exactly once and report uncertain close explicitly without retry. Preserve O_EXCL and no-reentry behavior.
